scale: 0-5 per dimension (0 = absent; 5 = complete, measured, and operated). Overall is the mean of the five surface scores.

surfaces.rationale: Manifest format, verification, revocation, and the live inventory are all measured and traced to source; the format is version-locked to 0 with no PQ upgrade path, which caps migration design at 2.
Generation exists (validation_create, token/seed config) but is secp256k1-only in three hardcoded places, and the only in-tree path warns about CLI secret leakage.
Rotation and revocation semantics are specified and live rotation is observed (16/25 rotated), but there is no automation, no scheduling, no expiry, and manifest creation exists only in tests.
No detection machinery exists; recovery from master-key compromise is terminal (new identity + list reconfiguration). Nothing to measure beyond the absence itself.
PQ rates and manifest-size impacts are freshly measured and modelled, but zero PQ support exists in-tree and the size blow-up (32-146x) has no designed mitigation.
